<!-- pr-reviewer: 8d7753e452fc005067db525c107ad40753f98aaa -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The post uses the shared explanation helper. Explain off keeps the existing program bytes. The new word meanings have public source notes. No UI, dependency, or build-control file changed.

Local checks used upstream/main at 03dc12c6af2bf1b39125d8eec5d60cf6d682170b. The trial merge was clean: this main was already an ancestor of the PR head.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: 504 passed, 0 failed. This includes the 3 new Explain tests.
- App integration tests: `conformance` 7; `tormach_end_units` 7; `tormach_fourth_axis` 12; `tormach_post` 10; `tormach_program_end` 3; `tormach_safe_retract` 4; `tormach_toolchange_lift` 3. All 46 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The quick-gate plan was read. The full quick gate was not run. Tests above cover the changed post and its program files.

Safety checks: all 13 new golden files were checked line by line (866 lines). Each changed line adds only an inert parenthesized comment. All existing executable bytes remain equal. No existing golden file changed.

Mutation checks used only the local review copy. With the old post restored, the matrix test and the conformance test each failed. With the explanation declaration removed, all 3 new tests failed. With the helper call removed, all 3 new tests failed. After the PR code was restored, all 3 passed. The worktree has no code changes.

Requested before merge: none.

No physical machine test was done. The lathe post is outside this change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
